title: PNVF's Lao to hand out incentives for eventual gold medalists in Asiad beach volley
summary: The Alas Pilipinas beach squad which will eventually emerge on top of the beach volleyball contest at the 20th Asian Games Aichi-Nagoya 2026 will receive an extra incentive.
